reason: A command-line project-analysis tool that statically scans DeepSeek Harness plugins for suspicious imports, code execution, data exfiltration patterns, obfuscation, credentials, URLs, shell commands, and install-time scripts using AST analysis, deobfuscation, and regex heuristics.

summaries.zh: 一个通过 AST 分析、反混淆和正则启发式方法，对 DeepSeek Harness 插件源代码及安装脚本进行安装前静态扫描的命令行工具。
summaries.en: A command-line tool that statically scans DeepSeek Harness plugin source files and install scripts before installation using AST analysis, deobfuscation, and regex heuristics.

capabilities: Scans plugin source files and package manifests
Performs static AST analysis of JavaScript
Decodes selected obfuscated string forms for secondary scanning
Applies regex heuristics to code and non-code files
Returns human-readable findings, JSON output, and exit codes for CI gating
